reconstruction.note: 123 is the minimal reconstruction that reconciles the marked multi-run -3/-4 capture gaps while treating HAG-R047 as a blank/transient report rather than an additional completed drill. It is a research reconstruction, not direct run-counter evidence.

cleanSingleRunCondition.conclusion: Consistent with independent integer settlement around a fractional mean of 1.35; no detected serial dependence. This does not prove the game uses Bernoulli settlement.

deterministicCarryTest.model: single conserved fractional phase; each run subtracts exactly 1.35; display is integer floor-state difference
deterministicCarryTest.reason: Clean adjacent -2/-2 outcomes occur. A 0.35 fractional increment cannot cross two integer boundaries on consecutive runs under a single conserved phase. Exhaustive phase scan also yields no admissible phase.

statSettlement.constantCarryReason: A constant sub-unit increment crossing integer thresholds can generate at most two adjacent integer gap lengths; observed confirmed gaps span 13 through 17.
statSettlement.note: The expected-double figure is a diagnostic using endpoint rates, not a fitted game mechanic.

established: The configured condition cost is fractional (1.35%).
Observed per-run condition display settles to integers -1/-2.
A simple single-phase deterministic carry accumulator does not reproduce the clean ordered condition observations.
Endpoint stat gains exceed directly rendered report gains by two points.
supportedNotProven: Independent stochastic integer settlement is compatible with the condition frequency and serial tests.
Per-stat low-probability settlement is compatible with the gain event pattern.
unresolved: Whether Resource Coach uses the same settlement architecture.
Whether the coach preview interval endpoints are stochastic quantiles, rounded expectations, or another renderer.
